metadata.description: Live AI-powered 3D design environment for Claude Code. Build, modify, and export 3D objects via chat with a real-time viewer at http://localhost:3030.

plugins.name: 3d-agent
plugins.description: Live 3D design environment. Eight subagents (Engineer/Designer, 3D Specialist, Manager, plus expertise in 3D printing, manufacturing, materials, CAD), eight slash commands, and a Three.js viewer with WebSocket live updates. Single-file .3dap project bundles for sharing.
